acceptanceCriteria.text: Media metadata is paginated and preview requests occur only when media is needed; upload and preview preserve Firebase token and project authorization plus defined error mappings.
App Check and rate limiting support observe-only and enforce modes with tests for valid, missing, invalid, over-limit, and rollback paths.
API and media telemetry uses only the approved non-PII allowlist and never exposes credentials or Drive identifiers beyond the existing contract.
Project deletion behavior and tests remain compliant with the accepted local-first administrator decision.

checkpointPayload.description: Make media loading demand-driven and add tested App Check, rate limiting, safe telemetry, and existing authorization guarantees to privileged Next.js APIs while preserving deletion lifecycle behavior.
checkpointPayload.title: [web-backend-performance-optimization-03] Optimize media and protect privileged APIs
